caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic crock or storage jar with a rounded, slightly tapering body, two small loop handles positioned near the upper sides, and a thickened rim at the top. The crock is primarily a light tan or beige color, with blue decorative accents painted on its surface. There are blue brushstroke patterns on the front of the crock beneath the rim, consisting of two sets of three ovoid shapes, and a central motif below that resembles stylized leaves or a floral spray. Each handle has a touch of blue paint at the top. The composition is centered on the paper with the crock placed against a plain, light background. There are a few faint marks and shadows around the jar, providing a sense of depth and definition to the shape.
title: Pickle Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
